Builtin, stateless builtin, and precompile program definitions and migration helpers.

# Purpose
Defines the interface for built-in program handling in the runtime. It declares data structures for built-in programs, stateless built-in programs, precompile programs, temporary accounts, and Core BPF migration settings. The file also declares functions to initialize built-in program accounts, write built-in account data, query built-in and precompile lists, test whether a program is migrating or non-migrating, and migrate a built-in program to Core BPF.
